description: RPL messages (DIS/DIO/DAO/DAO-ACK per RFC 6550) with hardcoded independent vectors from spec.

vectors.name: dio_base
vectors.description: LICHEN root RPL DIO whose DODAGID is AddrForKey for the deterministic all-zero identity seed, with the mandatory current SCHC Rule Version option.

vectors.name: dio_non_root
vectors.description: LICHEN non-root parent DIO propagates the root's AddrForKey DODAGID and mandatory current SCHC Rule Version unchanged.

vectors.name: dio_explicit_version_2
vectors.description: An explicit single canonical version option is preserved byte-for-byte so admission can reject a genuine remote mismatch.

vectors.name: dio_malformed_version_length_zero
vectors.description: A Type 0x13 option with Length zero is not canonical and cannot be serialized.

vectors.name: dio_malformed_version_length_two
vectors.description: A Type 0x13 option with Length two is not canonical and cannot be serialized.

vectors.name: dio_duplicate_version_option
vectors.description: Two otherwise canonical Type 0x13 options are rejected rather than collapsed or rewritten.

vectors.name: dao_base
vectors.description: Base RPL DAO without DODAGID: D flag is clear, so Rule 4 does not match and the packet uses uncompressed fallback.

vectors.name: dis_base
vectors.description: Normal DODAG Information Solicitation: zero flags, zero reserved, no options (RFC 6550 6.2).

vectors.name: dis_flags_ignored_on_receive
vectors.description: RFC 6550 6.2 DIS flag bits are unused: senders MUST zero them and receivers MUST ignore them, so a decoder preserves rather than rejects or masks any flags value.

vectors.name: dis_solicited_no_dodagid_match
vectors.description: No-DODAGID solicitation via Solicited Information option (RFC 6550 6.7.9): type 7 length 19, RPLInstanceID 0, VID flags 0xC0 (V+I set, D clear so the carried DODAGID is not matched), AddrForKey DODAGID of the deterministic all-zero identity seed, and DODAGVersionNumber 66.

vectors.name: dis_truncated
vectors.description: A DIS shorter than its two-byte base object is rejected.

vectors.name: dis_nonzero_reserved
vectors.description: A nonzero DIS Reserved byte violates RFC 6550 6.2 and is rejected instead of ignored.

vectors.name: dao_ack_accept
vectors.description: Successful DAO acknowledgement: status 0, D flag clear so no DODAGID is carried (RFC 6550 6.5).

vectors.name: dao_ack_status_rejected
vectors.description: Non-success DAO-ACK: the codecs carry Status as a raw byte (no enum), so non-zero values are preserved verbatim.

vectors.name: dao_ack_with_dodagid
vectors.description: D-flag DAO-ACK carries the AddrForKey DODAGID of the deterministic all-zero identity seed after the four-byte base.

vectors.name: dao_ack_too_short
vectors.description: A DAO-ACK shorter than its four-byte base object is rejected.

vectors.name: dao_ack_missing_dodagid
vectors.description: D flag set without the sixteen DODAGID bytes that must follow is rejected instead of misparsed.

vectors.name: dao_ack_status_alternate_parent_boundary
vectors.description: Status 127 is preserved as the upper alternate-parent recommendation boundary.

vectors.name: dao_ack_status_rejection_boundary
vectors.description: Status 128 is preserved as the lower outright-rejection boundary.

vectors.name: dao_ack_status_maximum
vectors.description: The complete Status octet is significant, including rejection code 255.

vectors.name: dao_ack_nonzero_reserved_flags
vectors.description: Reserved DAO-ACK flag bits are rejected by the strict LICHEN wire profile.

vectors.name: dao_ack_malformed_options_d0
vectors.description: D=0 followed by a truncated type-5 option is rejected.

vectors.name: dao_ack_malformed_options_d1
vectors.description: D=1 followed by a truncated type-5 option is rejected.

vectors.name: dodag_config_type4_default
vectors.description: Canonical DODAG Configuration with the LICHEN defaults and all flags clear.

vectors.name: dodag_config_type4_all_defined_flags
vectors.description: Gateway-centric, RFC A, and PCS fields occupy bits 7, 3, and 2..0 respectively and every numeric field round-trips.

vectors.name: dodag_config_type4_short_data
vectors.description: Data Length 13 truncates Lifetime Unit and is rejected.

vectors.name: dodag_config_type4_trailing_data
vectors.description: Data Length 15 is rejected rather than partially parsing a canonical option plus trailing data.

vectors.name: dodag_config_type4_reserved_flag
vectors.description: LICHEN reserves flag bits 6..4 and rejects them before state mutation.

vectors.name: dodag_config_type4_reserved_octet
vectors.description: The Reserved octet after OCP must be zero.

vectors.name: rpl_target_type5_host
vectors.description: Canonical LICHEN RPL Target: Data Length 18, zero flags, Prefix Length 128, and a complete IPv6 address.

vectors.name: rpl_target_type5_nonzero_flags
vectors.description: LICHEN reserves all RPL Target flags and rejects any nonzero value.

vectors.name: rpl_target_type5_short_data
vectors.description: A type-5 option with Data Length 17 is not the canonical /128 LICHEN profile.

vectors.name: rpl_target_type5_trailing_data
vectors.description: A type-5 option with trailing data and Data Length 19 is rejected rather than partially parsed.

vectors.name: rpl_target_type5_non_host_prefix
vectors.description: The LICHEN DAO profile permits only host routes, so Prefix Length 127 is rejected even with Data Length 18.

vectors.name: transit_type6_node_owned
vectors.description: Canonical node-owned Transit Information: Data Length 20, E clear, and the mandatory Parent Address.

vectors.name: transit_type6_external
vectors.description: The E bit represents external reachability while the Parent Address remains mandatory.

vectors.name: transit_type6_short_data
vectors.description: Data Length 19 truncates the mandatory Parent Address and is rejected.

vectors.name: transit_type6_trailing_data
vectors.description: Data Length 21 is rejected rather than partially parsing a canonical option plus trailing data.

vectors.name: transit_type6_missing_parent
vectors.description: The RFC four-byte form is outside the LICHEN non-storing profile because it omits the Parent Address.

vectors.name: transit_type6_reserved_flag
vectors.description: Reserved Transit flag bits must be zero; E is the only defined flag.
